general.notes: Passive Direct Attach Cable (DAC), Twinax copper; not an optical transceiver. Cable lengths 0.5 to 3 m; AWG30 (0.5 m, 1 m, 1.5 m variants) and AWG26 (2 m, 3 m). Minimum bend radius AWG30: 23 mm; AWG26: 28 mm. RoSH compliant. Vendor identified via smartoptics.com footer only.
general.suggestions: Schema reach_km may be better served by a cable_length_m field for passive DAC products. mounting_type 'Pluggable' inferred from 'fits into QSFP56 ports'; not a literal datasheet phrase.
